label: LM2596 (TO220)
description:
LM2596 3A 150KHz 40V Buck DC to DC in TO220-5 package.


The LM2596 can be viewed as a more advanced version of the LM2576. It has the same pinout, but the higher switching frequency allows smaller inductors and capacitors as external components, and higher efficiencies can be obtained.


Manufacturers of the LM2596 are H&M Semi (HM2596), ON Semi, Texas Instruments, XLSEMI (XL2596).
